hypotheses.S0_native_endpoints_are_consistent: The native branches evaluated from every screening layer agree within 1e-4 logits.
hypotheses.S1_known_L9H8_is_rediscovered: L9H8 ranks among the five largest positive individual boundary-edge mediators.
hypotheses.S2_additional_later_consumer_exists: At least one individual boundary edge after Layer 9 mediates at least 10% of the signed L8H2 cue-edge effect.
hypotheses.S3_boundary_edges_explain_each_attention: At at least one layer, freezing all boundary-source edges mediates 20% more effect than freezing the single best head at that layer.
hypotheses.S4_destination_attention_has_nonboundary: At at least one layer, freezing the complete destination attention change mediates 20% more effect than freezing all boundary-source edges.
